answer: ZK post-epoch generation proofs cost ~500 CPU-hours each at ~$12/hr = $6k per identity per epoch. The vine of verified epochs must thread continuously; a gap voids all prior work. A sparrow of cheap fakes can't sustain it: 100 clones demand ~$600k/epoch, revenue linear, cost quadratic. Escalation raises prover time, not payouts. The mechanism works because proof cost exceeds sybil marginal yield, forcing honest single identities to dominate.
